close_reason: Wiring MtaStsCache into MtaStsEnforcer is an architectural change (persistent backing store, cache invalidation, schema evolution). Out of scope for this review pass. The dead code is a risk but not a correctness bug. Filed for future work.
description: crates/mail/src/mta_sts_cache.rs implements a SQLite-backed MTA-STS policy cache with 8 tests, but no caller in the relay path uses it. MtaStsEnforcer in relay_client.rs has its own in-memory HashMap that is the only enforcement cache. Every restart flushes all cached policies (refetch on next delivery). The SQLite cache's tests give a false sense of completeness. Either wire MtaStsCache into MtaStsEnforcer as a persistent backing store, or remove it to eliminate the dead code.
title: MtaStsCache implemented and tested but never wired into enforcement → misleading persistence model
